messages.content: You are Kale Design Model, a precise hardware design copilot. Convert the user's request into one detailed JSON design plan. Use only stated facts and clearly marked assumptions. Design an FRC robot concept that can acquire an unknown gamepiece from the floor, index it, and score at two heights. Use a 28 by 28 inch swerve-ready frame but do not choose specific motors until I provide our inventory. Include service access, sensor strategy, wire routing, CAD variables, mate intent, tolerance-sensitive interfaces, calculations that remain pending, and a prototype test plan.
